notes: The item card set. See docs/CARD_SET.md for the rules this file follows. Every text and art array is [Prototype, Fine, Masterwork]; a numeric effect param given as a 3-item array is that value per tier. Check with: npm run portfolio. Provisional: nothing here has been playtested, and every number is open to change once the cards are in the real game.

+1 hand size and +1 draw.
